meta.data_description_zh:
1. 採用健保門診明細檔(H_NHI_OPDTE)之「國際疾病分類號」及健保住院明細檔
(H_NHI_IPDTE)之「主次診斷代碼」欄位，符合心血管疾病定義之編碼範圍(詳細
編碼請見附錄一)且符合一年內門診診斷 2 次(含)以上或住院 1 次(含)以上，定義
為心血管疾病患者。
2. 考量首年之健保資料難以區分盛行、新發個案，為取得有效心血管疾病的新發個
案，擷取年份從2001至2023年。
3. 資料清整流程詳請見附錄二。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，身分證字號、
院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位均
經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通
過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
2. 本資料庫涵蓋範圍已初步篩選心血管疾病相關常用欄位，資料格式請依欄位勾選
表配合各資料庫使用手冊對照參考。
3. 申請本資料庫仍應考量所需研究之主題特性，應用時應注意資料使用限制，歡迎
回饋使用意見。
meta.primary_keys_raw:
1. 個人身分證字號(ID)及醫療機構代碼(HOSP_ID)經加密處理。
2. 本檔主鍵為個人加密身分證字號(ID)。
3. 本檔與其他就醫資料檔比對的鍵值：個人加密身分證字號(ID)。
4. 本主檔與對照檔(CVD_CTRL)之配對組別欄位(SUBCLASS)有相同數值者，為同
一組別之病例對照個案。

meta.data_description_en:
1. Using the "International Classification of Disease code" field in the NHI Outpatient Detail File (H_NHI_OPDTE) and the "primary/secondary diagnosis code" field in the NHI Inpatient Detail File (H_NHI_IPDTE), cases falling within the coding range that meets the definition of cardiovascular disease (see Appendix 1 for detailed codes) and having 2 or more outpatient diagnoses or 1 or more hospitalizations within one year are defined as cardiovascular disease patients.
2. Because it is difficult to distinguish prevalent cases from newly diagnosed cases using the first year of NHI data, data from 2001 to 2023 were extracted in order to obtain valid newly diagnosed cardiovascular disease cases.
3. See Appendix 2 for details of the data-cleaning process.
meta.notes_en: Confirms whether the cancer originates in a paired organ or on one side of the body. Applies only to the primary tumor site. 0: Not a paired organ; 1: Primary origin on the right; 2: Primary origin on the left; 3: Unilateral involvement only, but origin (left/right) unclear; 4: Bilateral involvement but laterality of origin unclear, record describes a single primary (uncommon) — e.g. single-histology tumor in both ovaries; bilateral retinoblastomas; bilateral Wilms tumors; 5: Paired organ, midline tumor; 9: Paired organ, laterality unclear.
meta.primary_keys_en:
1. Personal ID and hospital code (HOSP_ID) are encrypted.
2. The primary key of this file is the encrypted personal ID.
3. The key value to match with other medical records files: encrypted personal ID.
4. Cases in the main file that have the same value in the对照档(SUBCLASS) field as those in the对照档(CVD_CTRL) are cases from the same matched group.

tables.data_description_en: 1. Persons with no cardiovascular disease-related healthcare visit record within the data extraction period were matched 1:1 on sex (ID_S), age at diagnosis (INDEX_AGE) and year of diagnosis (INDEX_YEAR) with each patient in the cardiovascular disease main file, defining the cardiovascular disease control group.
tables.notes_en:
1. 2. Applicants for this database should still consider the characteristics of the research topic, observe the restrictions on data use when applying the data, and feedback on use is welcome.

4. Records of this control file and the main file (CVD) with the same value in the matching group field (SUBCLASS) are case-control subjects of the same group.

tables.data_description_en:
1. Patients with coronary artery disease were defined as those whose "international classification of diseases code" in the NHI outpatient detail file (H_NHI_OPDTE) or "principal and secondary diagnosis codes" in the NHI inpatient detail file (H_NHI_IPDTE) fall within the code range for coronary artery disease (ICD-9-CM: 410-414; ICD-10-CM: I20-I25) and who had 3 or more outpatient diagnoses or 1 or more inpatient diagnoses within one year.
2. Because it is difficult to distinguish prevalent from incident cases in the first year of NHI data, cases were extracted from 2001 to 2023 in order to obtain valid incident coronary artery disease cases.
3. For the data cleaning process, see Appendix 2.
tables.notes_en:
1. This database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been deleted, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insurance unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of medical visit and date of admission have been masked. The data can only be used within the independent work area set up by the Ministry, and only statistical results that have passed review may be taken out, so that the data application and disclosure cannot identify specific individuals.
2. The scope of this database has been preliminarily screened to commonly used coronary artery disease-related fields; for data formats, refer to the field checklist together with the manual of each database.
3. Applicants for this database should still consider the characteristics of the research topic, observe the restrictions on data use when applying the data, and feedback on use is welcome.

3. Key for linking with other healthcare visit data files: the encrypted personal ID number (ID).
4. Records of this main file and the control file (CAD_CTRL) with the same value in the matching group field (SUBCLASS) are case-control subjects of the same group.
